title: Marguerite and the Vector
author: Ada Vane
blurb: Bram Delacroix, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
